_readme: The arguments for Holdfast bond 1, in the order create_bond takes them, kept as a file
rather than typed into a shell twice. The zero-value simulation and the funded send have to
carry byte-identical arguments or the simulation proves nothing about the send, which is the
entire reason create_bond reverts instead of refunding.
Chosen offline against _build/fixtures/holdfast/snap-gcp-terms-gzip.bin, which is the exact
gzip Wayback replays for this timestamp, and re-verified against the live archive by
_build/preflight-live.py: CDX 200 with the pin at row 0 of a 40-row window, snapshot 200,
digest ORCARP7HGOXUBBYK4LXACZM7GU5ZBMMY agreeing with the fetched bytes, gates 5 of 5.
anchor_words is a JSON array inside a string because GenVM contract arguments carry no list
type. payee is a string for the reason the create_bond docstring gives: the CLI coerces any
40-hex argument to an Address, which makes a typo indistinguishable from an intention.
commitment: Google will notify Customer at least 12 months before discontinuing any Service or associated material functionality, unless Google replaces such discontinued Service or functionality with a materially similar Service or functionality.
_anchorNote: Derived by the contract from the last path segment of the url and never supplied. 'terms' is five normalized characters, over the MIN_DERIVED_ANCHOR_CHARS floor of 3.
_terminalNote: 'governing law' is independent of the derived anchor 'terms' and of all five sections, in both directions, by equality and by substring, which is what GateSpec.validate requires and what gate D needs in order to be able to fail on its own.
_urlNote: The trailing slash is load-bearing. Wayback answers 302 for the id_ replay of https://cloud.google.com/terms and 200 for https://cloud.google.com/terms/, with a byte-identical 14-digit timestamp in the Location, so it is URL normalisation and not snapshot substitution. _derive_anchor skips empty path segments, so the slash does not change the derived anchor.
